text: MitosisEngine division criterion — OWNER DECISION, not fixed by the calibration work (827a96e). _check_splits requires all(t > split_threshold) over split_patience consecutive steps. With a correctly derived bar: one fixed input gives 31 cells / 1051 splits, 8 inputs in rotation give 2 cells / 0 splits — tension exceeds the bar on 50% of steps under rotation but the longest run is 2 against the 3 required, because tension follows the input and varying input makes it oscillate. The engine can only divide when fed the same thing repeatedly, the opposite of novelty-driven division. Changing all(...) to something like mean(recent) > bar would allow it, but that changes what the engine means by sustained tension. Measured in docs/mitosis-calibration.md. Also still open: MitosisC.__init__ force-grows by cloning cells[0], which merge_cells deletes within ~10 steps.
